SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=su.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE su.id=#{userId} AND su.status='active' AND p.permission_key=#{permission} AND ((ur.scope_type='asset' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(#{assetId} AS CHAR)) OR (r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')))
mapper.update: UPDATE sensor_agent SET platform=#{platform}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{sensorId} AND status IN ('pending', 'active', 'offline')

mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sensor_config WHERE sensor_id=#{sensorId} AND config_version=#{configVersion}
